name: remove
summary: Hides an element outright, or within a media query: from a breakpoint up with min, up to it with max, or between two breakpoints. One breakpoint on its own hides the element at exactly that width, a single pixel, and prints a warning: pass only for that.
caveats: With one argument the element is hidden at exactly that width, `(width: 768px)`, which is a single pixel, and the mixin prints a warning. Write `only` for that width, or `min`, `max` or a range for anything wider. 3.0.0 will refuse the one-argument form.
A `display` written after the include, in the same rule, is emitted after the `@media` block and wins over it. Write it before the include.

arguments.name: $params
accepts: one breakpoint, for exactly that width and no other, which prints a warning: write only instead
only plus a breakpoint, for exactly that width
min or max plus a breakpoint
a start and an end breakpoint
